description: Read the social marketing catalogue with combined filters and pagination (free) (free)

category.description: Case-insensitive category substring. All supplied filters are combined.

categoryExact.description: Exact case-sensitive category from GET /v1/smm-categories, trimmed. Combined with category when both are supplied.

limit.description: Decimal integer; no empty, signed, fractional, exponent or leading-zero representation.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into filtered results. Provider ordering is preserved; pages are not a locked snapshot.

q.description: Case-insensitive words; every word must occur in name or category. Search stays local to the catalogue.

sellable.description: true filters by configured purchase-cost cap at the minimum valid quantity; false applies no sellability filter. Not an availability or delivery guarantee.

name: smm_services
